sc: An 'Impish' Title Scroll (Untradeable) is an item that can be obtained from Purple Christmas Presents from the 2024 Christmas event onward.
The collection must be turned in to Isaura directly to obtain this thread.
The academy full helm is a full helm obtained from the tutorial of combat academy, in which the player got it from the melee combat set.
Adamant crossbow (unstrung) is an unfinished crossbow which can be created at level 43 Fletching by joining a maple stock with adamant limbs, granting 58 Fletching experience.
The Ancient hilt is an item that can be obtained by defeating TzKal-Zuk in hard mode.
It can be obtained by opening an elite reward casket as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.
The augmented elite Dracolich chaps is created by using an augmentor on an elite Dracolich chaps or by upgrading an augmented Dracolich chaps.

Banite armour set.x: Banite armour set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

Banite armour set + 3.x: Banite armour set + 3 is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: The Big Book o' Piracy is a reward from the quest Pieces of Hate.

It can be recharged by using Braindeath 'rum' on the book (or drinking 'rum' while carrying the book) which can be purchased from Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' or The Other Inn on Mos Le'Harmless or bartender in The Rusty Anchor in Port Sarim.

Blessed Sentinel Boots.x: Blessed Sentinel Boots is a feet slot cosmetic override that is part of the Blessed Sentinel set.

sc: The Dark crystal (reduced melee) is one of the debuff crystals dropped by bosses during Morvran's Slayer challenge.
It is not dropped by any specific monster.

sc: It may only be made by using a dragon kite ornament kit (sp) on a regular dragon kiteshield.
Embalmer's Log is a book found in the Grand Library of Menaphos.
It is obtained from the second bookcase on the eastern wall in the south-eastern corner of the second level.
Environmental effects (part 1) is a book obtained while training Dungeoneering as a reward for completing a dungeon which appears by the exit door after the Luminescent icefiend is killed.
Once the book has been obtained once it is impossible to obtain it again.
Ethical Concerns can be obtained from excavating Aughra remains and Moksha device excavation hotspots at the Orthen Dig Site.
The firemaker's trousers are obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
Contrary to popular belief it can be earned in any circus activities and not just the firemaking ones; only a score of 501-1000 points is needed and the completion of the Acrobat's costume.
If players lose this item, they can talk to Balthazar Beauregard to obtain it.
The focus sight is a headband dropped by desert strykewyrms.
It is made by using class 4 sacred clay on a creation kiln, requiring 60 Cooking.
Golden lava eel eggs are a reward from Fishing, fishing lava eel, used in the Aquarium of a player-owned house.
As a rare reward from fishing lava eel (level 53 Fishing and Heroes' Quest required) -- approximately 3 hours on average to get the egg.

Oh dear." A failed teleport does not use a charge. It is possible to be teleported to the same location more than once in a row.
sc: It was formerly a reward from the Mobilising Armies minigame, and could be purchased from War-chief Reeves.
The greater runic staff is a reward from the Runespan that can be purchased from Wizard Finix in his shop, Wizard Finix's Runecrafting Shop.
The leather can be crafted into dragonhide bodies, saving even more space and granting Crafting experience.
The Hazelmere's gummy rings are an item obtained during the 2023 Halloween event from Party and Smashing Pumpkins.
The Het mask is a cosmetic reward found in the Het tomb accessible after the Our Man in the North quest.
Hornless unicornfly in amber is one of the Insects of the Desert found in Menaphos.
It can be found while pickpocketing the menaphite marketeers or the gullible tourist.
A huge dungeoneering lamp is a reward from the Sinkholes Distraction and Diversion.

sc: An ink shooter token is an item that can be won from a summer piñata loot bag, received upon destroying a summer loot piñata, or through various stores on the beach, depending on the year.
It, along with the regular Prayer master skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached virtual level 120 Prayer.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Prayer master skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has virtual level 120 Prayer.
The Inverted Strength skillcape token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that reach level 99 Strength during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
Prior to the Law Talisman Changes update on the 7 May 2008, players could only obtain the law talisman as a reward from completing the Troll Stronghold quest.
The law talisman is no longer a reward from that quest, but rather, a drop from various monsters.

Legatus Maximus Platebody.x: The Legatus Maximus Platebody is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by completing Children of Mah. It is part of the Legatus Maximus outfit.

sc: The light boots is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter and is part of the Light outfit.

tx: Additionally, they can be received training any skill during the event.
sc: Maize Maze entry token (triple loot) is a seasonal item obtained randomly while skilling while Harvest Hollow is active, excluding combat and Dungeoneering.
They can be redeemed for earned entry with triple loot for the Maize Maze, with each redeemed token yielding a point.
The token is a possible reward from the spoils awarded by the Skaraxxi encounter in the Maize Maze.

sc: Mariner Cutlass is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased alongside its off-hand variant for 4 Showdown Sigils from the Showdown Store.
A marmaros guard is a main-hand necromancy weapon available in Daemonheim.
It can be made using ensouled marmaros bars at level 24 Smithing.
A medium XP lamp (Herblore) is a fairly common prize from Treasure Hunter.
The memoriam crystal z02 is found on Freneskae.

Mune.x: Mune is an activity pet related to Area Task achievements. It can be unlocked by spotting the Mune non-player character in any of five regions, having completed the respective elite task achievements for that region.

New Varrock Zombie Legs.x: The New Varrock Zombie Legs are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the New Varrock Zombie outfit from Aris' Reward Shop after completing Dimension of Disaster.

sc: The Ocean's Mage Orb is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by progressing through the RunePass.
The off-hand exquisite longsword is a multi-tier weapon obtained from the Squeal of Fortune.
However, this weapon can still be obtained and used by free-to-play players.

sc: It was first available from Going Like Clockwork in 2017.
It's made by using a calquat keg with a finished barrel of ale after brewing Pigswill and randomly getting a mature batch.
Red Candy Cane is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by redeeming a Red Candy Cane Token.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
A ring of recoil is made by enchanting a sapphire ring with the Lvl-1 Enchant spell.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 rune bars, requiring 1,200 progress to complete, granting a total of 480 Smithing experience.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 8 rune bars and a rune pickaxe + 2, requiring 1,440 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,920 Smithing experience.
It is obtained by attacking the Penance King once.
The sealed message is obtained during The Darkness of Hallowvale quest.
Though rare, all Imcando metal pieces are found within the Warforge Dig Site and the material caches outside the dig site which require level 76 Archaeology to access.
The slave robe is obtained by trading any robe with a slave for use in The Tourist Trap quest.
If the player loses it, it is also dropped by Rowdy Slaves in the mine.
The slime hunter boots are a reward from the Slime is of the Essence promotion.

The starfire gauntlets are an item that can be bought from the DXP Token Store, the Portable Trader or made by combining 2,000 starlight ore during the promotion period, or obtained later from Vic's Store.
The strange box only stacked when there were no available spaces for it to spawn another box into.
Casting high or low alchemy on the box, dropping it, or banking it also caused another box to spawn.

sc: Like all obsidian weapons, this staff cannot be made using the Crafting skill.
Unstable protean planks are a Treasure Hunter reward from the Cerberus Rush promotion.
The experience given by each unstable protean plank scales according to the player's Construction level at certain intervals.
An upgraded fletching size enhancer is a reward from the Parcels from the Dead event.
Previously, it could be obtained through the Travelling Artisan events.
The ring could be purchased for 1,750 Contribution Points from the Gielinor Games Reward Shop during the event.
There was a glitch during the games where rings purchased from the Gielinor Games Reward Shop would cause players to disconnect if they tried to destroy them.

tx: Players may use the pyre logs, along with a set of shade remains (Loar, Phrin or Riyl), on one of the numerous funeral pyres located to the south and to the west of Mort'ton's centre. The pyre can then be lit, which releases the shade and rewards Firemaking and Prayer experience, as well as some coins or a key which will appear on the nearby stone stand. The type of key rewarded solely depends on the type of remains that are cremated, and do not depend on the logs used.
sc: To make willow pyre logs, players must first obtain some sacred olive oil.
Once the sacred oil has been obtained players will need to use three doses of it upon some willow logs.
Yuzu is an quest item that can spawn during one of the puzzles during Desperate Times.
Zamorak vines are a type of jadinko vine found by catching zamorak jadinkos.
